principles: Balance richness with acidity or fresh crunch.
Match cooking intensity: grilled proteins pair better with charred/roasted sides.
Avoid duplicate heavy textures (e.g., two creamy starches).
Include at least one color/fiber-forward side for plate balance.
For spicy proteins, add a cooling or neutral side.

weak_combo_rules.when: selected_sides contain 2+ of [Mac and Cheese, Loaded Mashed Potatoes, Scalloped Potatoes, Creamed Corn]
weak_combo_rules.warning: This may feel too heavy and one-note.

weak_combo_rules.when: protein in seafood AND selected_sides include 2 comfort_sides
weak_combo_rules.warning: Seafood usually tastes better with one lighter, brighter side.
Add a vegetable or salad for balance and color.

weak_combo_rules.when: flavor_style = spicy AND selected_sides lack cooling/fresh side
weak_combo_rules.warning: A cooling side improves contrast and keeps heat enjoyable.

recommendation_strategy.step_2: Score each side: +2 preferred tags, -2 avoid tags, +1 user flavor-style match, +1 time-limit fit.
recommendation_strategy.step_3: Return top 5 side suggestions; preselect top 2 if user is unsure.
recommendation_strategy.step_4: If weak combo rule triggers, show warning + 2–3 better swaps but allow continue.
